purpose: Confirm identity-bearing mask/cowl topology across anthropomorphic species masks and superhero cowls, including repeated component signatures across release variants.

evidence_policy.source: regenerated Rebrickable-derived physical component census after false-positive repairs

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Phoenix, Red Eyes and Dark Bluish Gray Goggles, Beak

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Bird (Phoenix) with Yellow Beak, Dark Bluish Gray Goggles, Red Eyes print

records.training_note: A standard cylindrical printed head carries eye/goggle/face information while a separate phoenix mask supplies beak and species silhouette. This is identity/species geometry rather than protective equipment.

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Bird (Eagle) with Yellow Beak and Medium Blue Feathers Print

records.training_note: Ewar's eagle identity is split between a standard printed head and separate beak/feather mask geometry. Shoulder-armor variation is orthogonal to the face route.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Equila / Ewar, Dual Sided, Eagle with Beak, Yellow Eyes / Orange Goggles Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Bird (Eagle) with Yellow Beak and Medium Blue Feathers Print

records.training_note: This release repeats the exact Ewar head-plus-mask topology despite different shoulder armor, confirming that non-head component variants should not create duplicate face-route semantics.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head The Flash, Dual Sided, Balaclava, Light Nougat Face, Dark Orange Eyebrows, Grin / Smile with Teeth Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask with Lightning Bolt Wings, Yellow Print (The Flash)

records.training_note: A later Flash head print still uses the same lightning-wing mask geometry as earlier releases. The printed under-mask state can vary while the silhouette-bearing cowl component remains stable.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Bruce Wayne (Batman), Eyebrows, Brown Cheek Lines, Lopsided Open Mouth Grin Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask, Batman Cowl with Blue Swimming Goggles Pattern

records.training_note: The Batman identity silhouette is carried by a separate cowl, with the swimsuit gag expressed as decoration on that same cowl geometry. The duck float is hipwear and correctly excluded from the headgear route after the classifier repair.

systemic_findings: Exact repeated head-plus-mask component signatures across release variants can support route-topology propagation even when unrelated armor/body components differ.
The same molded cowl can carry variant decoration while preserving a stable identity-geometry route.
Physical route topology and semantic function can be reviewed independently of later source-appearance pairing.
